text:
rachel: Heads-up: opening a small PR to unify terminology and snippet params across the docs site. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/650

rachel: Proposal: use the term 'model identifier' as the canonical phrase in prose, and `model_id` as the canonical API field. Add a short glossary entry and migration notes.

tim: Different wording than recent threads but I like it 44d. Why 'model identifier' vs 'handle'?

rachel: Two reasons: 1) more semantically neutral for customers, 2) reduces confusion with internal "handles" we use in infra.

kai: SGTM. For snippets, should we show the API field or the SDK parameter name?

amina: Show API field in the main example, then a small "SDK mapping" callout with concrete examples for Python/JS/Ruby. Keeps the canonical surface consistent.

rachel: Exactly. Example I plan to include: API-first example (yaml/json) then SDK mapping.

rachel: API example in the PR:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model_id": "redwood/fast-chat-v2",
  "input": "Hi"
}
```

rachel: JS mapping callout: 
```
// JS SDK maps to modelId
client.generate({ modelId: "redwood/fast-chat-v2", input: "Hi" })
```

rachel: Python mapping callout: 
```
# Python SDK
client.generate(model_id="redwood/fast-chat-v2", input="Hi")
```

kai: tiny nit: use consistent casing in callouts (camelCase for JS, snake_case for Python). Also add a one-line migration `sed` example to help bulk edits.

amina: I'll add a glossary entry: 'model identifier' definition + note about previous aliases (`model_name`, `model_handle`). Link it to the models catalog.

doc-bot: PR 650 created by rachel; reviewers requested: @tim, @amina. CI checks queued. :gear:

tim: Recommend adding a short line in the style guide about voice for error/fallback copy: prefer first-person plural + brief, neutral sentences. Example: 'We're routing your request to a slower model.'

rachel: Good call. I'll add that and a 1-line rule about contractions (allow "we're" in UI affordances).

amina: I'll run a grep + open follow-ups for any repos that still use `model_name`. Suggest using `git grep -n "model_name"` then open issues if matches are large.

doc-bot: CI passed for PR 650 :white_check_mark:.

rachel: Thanks all. I'll merge once Amina gives the quick grep + we have the glossary link. Will announce in #docs-updates after merge. :tada:
